{
	email admin@example.com
}

api.example.com {
	reverse_proxy api:3000
}

app.example.com {
	root * /var/www/app
	try_files {path} {path}/ /index.html
	file_server
	log
}

http://blog.example.com {
	root * /var/www/blog
	php_fastcgi blog:9000
	file_server
	log
}

example.com, www.example.com {
	root * /var/www/html
	file_server
	log
}
